weapon.label: Heavy gun damage
weapon.hint: Enemies who build mostly weapon items and shred you with bullets.

items.why: Cheap bullet resistance.
High bullet resistance, more at low health.
Barrier when you take a burst of bullet damage.
Active: nearly immune to bullets for a moment.
Stops the target from shooting at all.
Lowers the shooter's fire rate.
Slows the fire rate of anyone shooting you.
Deflects incoming bullets.
Reflects their bullet damage back at them.

spirit.label: Heavy spirit damage
spirit.hint: Enemies who build mostly spirit items and burst you with abilities.

items.why: Cheap spirit resistance.
High spirit resistance, more at low health.
Barrier when you take a burst of spirit damage.
Lowers the caster's spirit power.
Shorter stuns, slows and silences.
Active: remove their debuffs from you.
Parry and block an incoming ability.
Silence casters so they can't use abilities.
Less damage from big spirit hits.
Active: immune to their crowd control.
Silence and disarm their main threat.

vitality.label: Tanky enemies
vitality.hint: Enemies with lots of health, resistances or healing who won't die.

items.why: Cheap anti-heal on your spirit damage.
Anti-heal on your bullets.
Anti-heal and damage over time.
Bonus damage based on their max health.
Lowers their bullet resistance.
Your bullets lower their bullet resistance.
Bullets ignore part of their resistance.
Anti-heal on big spirit hits.
Aura damage based on their max health.
Stacking vulnerability to your spirit damage.
Headshots strip their resistances.
Reduces their damage and healing.

flying.label: Flying heroes
flying.hint: Heroes who fight from the air (for example Vindicta's flight). Hard to hit and hard to reach.

items.why: Stuns and pulls an airborne target to the ground.
Teleport straight to them, even in the air.
More damage against targets far away.
Big long-range damage with zoom to track them.
Faster bullets make moving targets easier to hit.
Fly up and fight them in the air.
